creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`muster pane new --cwd ../muster-1` does not resolve the path against the pane it is run from. The new pane lands in `$HOME` instead, and nothing says so: the command succeeds and returns a pane id.

Cost an integrator agent three panes and a recovery on 2026-09-06 - all three landed in `~`, and it only surfaced because a fresh Claude Code prompted to trust `/Users/amterp` rather than the worktree. An agent that did not prompt would have worked in the wrong directory silently.

Either resolve a relative path against the source pane's cwd, which is what somebody typing it in a pane means, or refuse one and say a path must be absolute. Silently substituting `$HOME` is the one answer that cannot be right.
title: 🧭 muster pane new --cwd silently ignores a relative path
